rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice when you mainly mean a lazy, uncaring person.

example.english: They do nothing but lie around all day; they’re a real slob.
example.traditional: 佢成日淨係識攤喺度，真係個懶鬼。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zing6 hai6 sik1 taan1 hai2 dou6 zan1 hai6 go3 laan5 gwai2

rows.note: Use this when the person's untidiness or poor personal hygiene is the main point.

example.english: Look at how dirty their clothes are—they’re such a slob.
example.traditional: 你睇吓佢件衫咁污糟，成個邋遢鬼咁。
example.jyutping: nei5 tai2 haa5 keoi5 gin6 saam1 gam3 wu1 zou1 seng4 go3 laat6 taat3 gwai2 gam3

rows.note: Use this only when “slob” refers to an obese person, not for laziness or untidiness.

example.english: That slob gets out of breath after walking a few steps.
example.traditional: 嗰個肥人行兩步就喘氣。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 fei4 jan4 hang4 loeng5 bou6 zau6 cyun2 hei3
